basis: Live epoch 18 crossed 840 seconds and remained productive beyond the nominal 15-minute boundary, while same-canonical overlap at 01:15 was not observed.
fallback_guarantee_target: If the active invocation disappears, keep a future canonical wake no more than one quarter-cycle away plus scheduler jitter; do not accidentally leave the RRULE parked on a missed phase whose next occurrence is one hour later.

independent_fast_wake_upgrade.producer: GitHub PR event lane; optional guarded Actions stale-owner producer

measurement.live_run_useful_span: May exceed 900 seconds; keep measuring continuous evidence rather than forcing artificial turn closure.
measurement.recovery_gap: Measure from last meaningful predecessor progress to first meaningful replacement-worker progress.
measurement.product_slo: Optimize wall-clock useful-work coverage union, not number of nominal 15-minute turns.
